components.name: Code

runtimeRules.rule: inline=true rejects copy=true, highlight=true or showLanguage=true; omitted options remain valid inline.

limitations: Copy requires trusted user activation in a secure browser context; denied/unavailable Clipboard API reports a manual-copy fallback.
Only bundled grammars are supported; highlighting is not syntax validation.
components.docs: Code(data) is a foundation component in base/code. value is required (at most 12000 Unicode code points). Optional language selects a bundled highlight.js grammar; missing/unknown languages stay plain text. No auto-detection or execution. Block defaults: highlight=true, copy=true, showLanguage=true. The fallback label is Plain text. Set each option false to opt out. inline=true stays text-only and rejects true for copy, highlight or showLanguage. CodeView(data) is a compatible alias.

examples.description: Minimal code example using supplied data.

components.name: Text
components.docs: Use for prose or labels. Newlines remain text; markup and code are not executed. Optional align: start, center, end. Size: xs=12, sm=14, md=16, lg=18 CSS pixels. Weight: regular=400, medium=500, semibold=600. Omitted typography inherits its context. Existing content and tone positions are unchanged.

examples.description: Minimal text example using supplied data.

components.name: Heading
components.docs: Use headings in a meaningful outline. Level defaults to 2 in the renderer.

examples.description: Minimal heading example using supplied data.

components.name: Badge
components.docs: A badge displays a supplied label; tone does not independently verify status. info, success, warning, and error use theme-aware soft surfaces with readable text. Pair status color with words; never use color alone.

examples.description: Minimal badge example using supplied data.

components.name: Divider
components.docs: Use sparingly between sections. It has no text or interaction.

examples.description: Minimal divider example using supplied data.

components.name: Alert
components.docs: Passive notice. It does not trigger a notification service or infer urgency. Tones info, success, warning, and error use semantic soft surfaces. Keep a visible title and description so meaning does not depend on color.

examples.description: Minimal alert example using supplied data.

components.name: Table

runtimeRules.rule: Column keys must be unique. Row keys must name declared columns; rows may omit a declared column.

components.docs: Columns have unique keys. Rows may omit a column, but may not introduce undeclared columns. Cells are plain scalar data.

examples.description: Minimal table example using supplied data.

components.name: Button
limitations: No host tools, navigation, account access or message sending.
components.docs: onPress is a runtime-issued local action. Use @Set, @Reset or Action; literal action-like objects are forbidden.

examples.description: Minimal button example using supplied data.

components.name: Input
components.docs: Pass a direct declared $variable to value to allow edits. Literal values render read-only. Draft text is not committed when validation fails.

examples.description: Minimal input example using supplied data.

components.name: Textarea
components.docs: Writable through a direct declared $variable; an invalid transaction must preserve the previous committed value.

examples.description: Minimal textarea example using supplied data.

components.name: Select

runtimeRules.rule: Option values must be unique. The current value must equal one supplied option value.

components.docs: Options have unique values. Current value must match one option.

examples.description: Minimal select example using supplied data.

components.name: RadioGroup

runtimeRules.rule: Option values must be unique. The current value must equal one supplied option value.

components.docs: Uses the same single-choice state contract as Select, with native labeled radios.

examples.description: Minimal radio example using supplied data.

components.name: Checkbox
components.docs: Pass a direct declared boolean $variable to checked for local edits.

examples.description: Minimal checkbox example using supplied data.

components.name: Switch
components.docs: A boolean local switch. It never changes external account or app settings.

examples.description: Minimal switch example using supplied data.

components.name: Slider

runtimeRules.rule: min < max; min <= value <= max; 0 < step <= max-min. If step is omitted the runtime uses 1.

components.docs: Requires finite min < max and value inside the range. Step is positive and cannot exceed the range.

examples.description: Minimal slider example using supplied data.

components.name: Icon
limitations: No remote SVG or arbitrary path data.
components.docs: Only exact bundled canonical names are accepted. Arguments: name, label, tone, size. Use null label for a decorative icon beside visible text. Use a nonempty label for an icon that conveys meaning alone. Tones: default, muted, info, success, warning, error. Sizes: 16, 20, 24, 32, 48; default 20. Tone communicates supplied meaning; it never verifies status. Public OpenAI Apps SDK UI glyphs are distinct from Inform UI role mapping.

examples.description: Minimal icon example using supplied data.

components.name: Stack
components.docs: Children belong to the selected profile. Gap is a finite design token; there is no arbitrary CSS.

examples.description: Minimal stack example using supplied data.

components.name: Row
components.docs: Defaults remain wrapping, natural child widths, centered cross-axis alignment and start justification. Optional options: wrap=nowrap keeps one row; distribution=equal gives each child an equal share; justify=between separates edge labels. Children can shrink and text can wrap within a child. Use Grid preserve for a fixed count of tracks. No arbitrary CSS.

examples.description: Minimal row example using supplied data.

components.name: Grid
components.docs: Columns: 1 through 8, default 2. Default responsive=stack preserves the existing behavior: one column when the root container is 480 CSS pixels or narrower. responsive=preserve retains the requested equal tracks on narrow screens. Use short labels and small gaps for dense tracks; it does not shrink fonts or crop content.

examples.description: Minimal grid example using supplied data.

components.name: Card
components.docs: Use a card for one coherent section. Card owns its child slot, not external services.

examples.description: Minimal card example using supplied data.

components.name: Box
components.docs: Box(children, options?) is a vertical flow, not an algorithm-specific component. Defaults: transparent background, no padding, md gap, no radius, auto width, no minimum height. background: transparent, surface, info, success, warning, error; semantic backgrounds use paired theme-aware text colors. padding/gap: none, xs, sm, md, lg, xl (0,4,8,12,16,24px). radius: none=0, sm=6, md=10, lg=16px. width: auto, full, grow (remaining Row space), xs=48, sm=64, md=96px; fixed tokens do not grow or shrink in a Row. minHeight: none=0, sm=24, md=32, lg=48px; content can grow taller. Nested Box can set a different surface. No arbitrary colors, CSS, HTML, selectors or URLs.

examples.description: Minimal box example using supplied data.
examples.source: root = Stack([Box([Text("A compact label", "default", "center", "sm")], {background: "info", padding: "sm", radius: "sm"})])

components.name: Image

runtimeRules.rule: src must be a bounded PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF base64 data URL or HTTPS URL with no whitespace. SVG data URLs are rejected. HTTPS still requires host approval to fetch.

limitations: HTTPS is syntactically allowed but remains blocked until the host media policy explicitly permits it. SVG data URLs are rejected.
components.docs: Alt text is required; empty alt is for decoration. The default renderer must not fetch a remote image without a host media allowlist.

examples.description: Minimal image example using supplied data.

components.name: Video
components.docs: Video(src,title,poster?,captions?) uses a native video element. No autoplay, third-party iframe, tracking or service dependency. Playback codecs depend on the browser. Supply captions for speech and describe silent visual media.

examples.description: Minimal video example using supplied data.
